spread--verb.def: To reach a wider area, or to cover a surface.
spread--verb.ex: The fire spread to the next field.

regret--noun.def: A sad feeling about something you did or failed to do.
regret--noun.ex: He spoke of his one great regret.

growing--adj.ex: There is growing concern about costs.
growing--adj.exTr: Maliyetler konusunda artan bir endişe var.

revenge--noun.def: Harm done to someone because they harmed you.

professional--noun.def: A person with a trained skill who is paid for it.
professional--noun.ex: Ask a professional to check the wiring.

genius--noun.def: Extremely great ability, or a person with it.

dna--noun.def: The material in cells that carries genetic information.
dna--noun.ex: The dna test confirmed the link.

lower--verb.def: To move something down, or to reduce an amount.

madame--noun.def: A French title used for a married woman.

suck--verb.def: To pull liquid or air into your mouth.
suck--verb.ex: The baby sucked the bottle dry.

particular--adj.def: One specific thing rather than others.
particular--adj.ex: Is there a particular book you want?
particular--adj.exTr: İstediğin belirli bir kitap var mı?

fixed--adj.ex: The rent is fixed for a year.

data--noun.def: Facts and numbers collected for study.
data--noun.ex: The data show a clear pattern.

jury--noun.def: A group of people who decide a case in court.

saving--noun.def: An amount of money you do not have to spend.
saving--noun.ex: The new bulbs bring a real saving.
saving--noun.exTr: Yeni ampuller gerçek bir tasarruf sağlıyor.

official--noun.def: A person with a position of authority in an organization.
official--noun.ex: A customs official checked our bags.
official--noun.exTr: Bir gümrük görevlisi çantalarımızı kontrol etti.

chase--verb.def: To run after someone to catch them.
chase--verb.ex: The dog chased the cat upstairs.
chase--verb.exTr: Köpek kediyi üst kata kadar kovaladı.

odd--adj.def: Strange, or not able to be divided by two.

sexy--adj.def: Physically attractive in a romantic way.
sexy--adj.ex: He wore a sexy black shirt.

shock--verb.def: To surprise and upset someone badly.

sexual--adj.def: Relating to sex or to the two sexes.

mercy--noun.def: Kindness shown when you could punish instead.

poison--verb.def: To harm or kill someone with a poison.

wound--verb.def: To injure someone, especially with a weapon.

crack--noun.def: A thin line where something has broken.
crack--noun.ex: There is a crack in the wall.

crack--verb.def: To break so that lines appear, or to open something hard.
crack--verb.ex: The glass cracked in the heat.

dawn--noun.def: The time when light first appears in the morning.

freak--verb.def: To react with sudden fear or anger, in informal speech.
freak--verb.ex: Do not freak out over one mistake.

prime--adj.def: Most important, or of the best quality.

concern--verb.def: To be about something, or to worry someone.

value--verb.def: To think something is important, or to say what it is worth.

media--noun.def: Newspapers, television and the internet as a group.
media--noun.ex: The media reported the story widely.

desire--verb.exTr: Her şeyden çok barış arzu ediyorlardı.

hook--noun.def: A bent piece of metal used to hang or catch something.
hook--noun.ex: Hang your coat on the hook.

hook--verb.def: To fasten or catch something with a hook.
hook--verb.ex: He hooked the rope to the boat.

literally--adv.def: In the exact sense of the words, not as an image.
literally--adv.ex: The word literally means water carrier.
literally--adv.exTr: Kelime tam anlamıyla su taşıyıcı demek.

rate--verb.def: To judge how good something is.

load--verb.def: To put goods into a vehicle, or to put data into a machine.
load--verb.ex: They loaded the van with boxes.

sue--verb.def: To take legal action against someone.
sue--verb.ex: She sued the company for damages.

remains--noun.def: The parts of something that are left, especially ancient ones.
remains--noun.ex: The remains date from Roman times.

decent--adj.def: Of an acceptable standard, or honest and fair.

tip--verb.def: To give extra money for service, or to make something lean over.

theme--noun.def: The main subject of a book, a talk or an event.
theme--noun.ex: Loss is the theme of the novel.

cast--noun.def: All the actors in a play or a film.
cast--noun.exTr: Oyuncu kadrosu bütün hafta prova yaptı.

cast--verb.def: To choose actors for a film, or to throw something.
cast--verb.ex: They cast her as the mother.

hunting--noun.def: The activity of chasing and killing wild animals.
hunting--noun.ex: Hunting is banned in this forest.

punch--noun.def: A hard blow with a closed hand.

punch--verb.def: To hit someone hard with a closed hand.
punch--verb.ex: He punched the wall in anger.

convinced--adj.def: Completely sure that something is true.
convinced--adj.ex: She is convinced he is innocent.

wolf--noun.def: A wild animal of the dog family that hunts in groups.
wolf--noun.ex: A wolf howled in the valley.

separate--verb.def: To divide things, or to stop living together.
separate--verb.ex: Separate the eggs from the flour.

shift--noun.def: A period of work, or a change in position or opinion.

expert--adj.def: Having great skill or knowledge in a subject.

row--verb.def: To move a boat using oars.

destiny--noun.def: What is believed to be certain to happen to someone.
destiny--noun.ex: He felt it was his destiny.

cure--verb.def: To make an illness or a person healthy again.

grade--verb.def: To give marks to work, or to sort by quality.

schedule--verb.def: To arrange for something to happen at a set time.
schedule--verb.ex: The flight is scheduled for noon.

range--verb.ex: Prices range from ten to fifty lira.
range--verb.exTr: Fiyatlar on ile elli lira arasında değişiyor.

progress--verb.def: To move forward or develop over time.

campaign--noun.def: A planned series of actions to reach an aim.
campaign--noun.ex: The campaign raised a million lira.

mass--noun.def: A large amount of matter, or its weight in physics.
mass--noun.ex: A mass of cloud covered the peak.

route--noun.def: The way you travel from one place to another.
route--noun.ex: The bus takes a longer route.
route--noun.exTr: Otobüs daha uzun bir güzergâh izliyor.

trace--verb.def: To find someone by following clues, or to copy a drawing.
trace--verb.ex: Police traced the call to a hotel.
trace--verb.exTr: Polis aramanın izini bir otele kadar sürdü.

sentence--verb.def: To officially state a criminal's punishment.
sentence--verb.ex: The court sentenced him to five years.
sentence--verb.exTr: Mahkeme ona beş yıl hapis verdi.

friendly--adj.def: Behaving in a kind and pleasant way.

charming--adj.ex: It is a charming little village.

sharp--adv.ex: The meeting starts at nine sharp.

squad--noun.def: A small group of soldiers, police or players.

screen--verb.def: To test people for an illness, or to show a film.
screen--verb.ex: The clinic screens patients for diabetes.

understanding--adj.def: Willing to forgive and to listen with sympathy.

understanding--noun.def: Knowledge of something, or sympathy for someone.
understanding--noun.ex: He has a deep understanding of the law.
understanding--noun.exTr: Hukuk konusunda derin bir kavrayışı var.

estate--noun.def: A large piece of land with a house, or an area of housing.
estate--noun.ex: They grew up on a housing estate.

gunshot--noun.def: The sound or the firing of a gun.

hug--noun.def: The act of putting your arms around someone.
hug--noun.ex: She gave her mother a long hug.

object--verb.def: To say that you disagree with something.

conference--noun.def: A large formal meeting for discussion.
